body.title: ci: add guard to fail builds on tracked generated/system files
body.body: This PR adds a CI guard step to fail builds if generated/system junk files are committed (e.g. .DS_Store, .coverage, htmlcov). The check runs early in both Rust and Python jobs to ensure repository hygiene and prevent accidental artifact commits.
